result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the bottom navigation area looks visually broken: the center tab/icon is obscured by a dark horizontal bar, making it hard to identify or use. I don’t see other major rendering problems in the visible content.

issues.description: The bottom navigation’s center item is partially covered by a dark horizontal bar/overlay, so the icon is not clearly visible.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area spacing and ensure no overlay or sticky element is covering the navigation bar.
